title: Member invitation UI is unreachable while the app tells people to ask for an invite
description:
**Found 2026-09-16 by the orphan survey on `77c09b`, which was itself prompted by `930da7`.**

`web/components/InviteMemberPanel.tsx` is imported by nothing, and it is the **only** caller of `web/lib/invitations.ts`. The panel and its entire API client are unreachable from the running app.

At the same time, `NoOrganizationPanel` — which IS mounted, through `MembershipShell` — renders this to a person with no organization:

> Ask an operator to invite you before using the workspace.

So the product tells people to request an invite from an operator, and gives the operator no way to send one.

## Why this is not just another orphan

`930da7` was a control a person could work around — the API existed and authority defaulted closed. This one is on the path to having any users at all. Story `786185` ("An operator invites a signup and the link is single use") sits under the waitlist epic and presumably assumes this works.

## Worth establishing before building

Check whether operators currently invite people some other way — a CLI, a console, a manual DynamoDB write. If there is a working out-of-band path, this is a convenience gap and should be priced accordingly. If there is not, then the invite flow does not exist in the product at all, and the copy in `NoOrganizationPanel` is a promise we do not keep.

Do not assume the panel is correct just because it exists. It was written, never wired, and never exercised against the real app — treat its behavior as unverified, the same way `TurnGrantPanel`'s was.

## Done when

An operator can invite a member from the running app and the invited person can act on it, or — if invitations are deliberately out-of-band for now — `NoOrganizationPanel` stops telling people to do something the product cannot support, and this card records where invitations actually happen.
